CONTROLS

HOW TO PLAY

01 / SHOOTER

A D Move left / right.
S Hold to charge, release to shoot.
Hit the green window. Corners are 3s.

02 / DEFENDER

← → Stay in front.
Space Jump to block.
Time your jump. Landing has a cooldown.

03 / THE DUEL

Share one keyboard. Switch roles after every shot. Five shots each. Highest score wins; a tie is a draw.

04 / YOUR RELEASE

Green = accurate shot. A defender can still block it. Nearly green goes in when open. Early or late misses.

Press Esc to pause. Touch buttons support simultaneous holds for two-player play on a shared screen.
